title: FemTheme Solo #019 · 여 토운드 밤쉘·스페인플라멩코글램·군인 테마
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a snow-covered stone plaza in soft daylight with light snow lying only on the ground, a fountain edge under snow, standard lamp posts and a waist-high railing, softly lit by blue-hour twilight and warm lamps, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her, NO dark background NO black void, ONE person standing, sharp focus from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in blue-hour twilight with warm lamps glowing, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

SUBJECT: ONE real adult Spanish woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, dramatic winged liner, a deep red lip, a passionate expression, warm olive skin, soft champagne-blonde hair styled in natural curls gathered into a high rounded puff, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large copper hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on copper chains of different lengths (a silver hammer head, a gold cube-shaped block), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and an extreme maximalist stack of well over ten rose-gold rings. Extremely long round nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
SUBJECT Physique: an extraordinarily curvaceous but athletic woman, far beyond any real person; a flat, firmly defined stomach with faint abdominal muscle lines, a very narrow waist, strong rounded shoulders and toned arms, powerful toned thighs and a high firm rounded rear, yet a colossal full bust and wide round hips that keep the dramatic hourglass shape; hard fit muscle under glowing skin, not bulky, not thin, not boyish; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
SUBJECT Outfit: Her skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a tilted olive-green military beret with a brass badge and two silver dog-tag chains around her neck, a micro strapless camouflage-pattern bandeau reduced to the narrowest possible strip only two fingers tall, stretched tightly across the middle of her bust and covering only what it must, and a minimal camouflage-pattern micro bikini bottom of one tiny low-rise opaque triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, the small opaque piece fully covering her, her stomach fully visible.
SUBJECT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on her hip.
SUBJECT Footwear: Extreme black thigh-high stiletto boots with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the twilight and the warm lamp light in soft glints, the light carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, the face toward the camera.
